args.decision_needed: The tenant of Flat 9, 59 Alder Lane reports the landlord's LG washing machine (there when they moved in) has stopped with a power failure; they say it can't be repaired (own web research, not confirmed by an engineer). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property and be taken with them when they leave. Please tell us: (1) do you consent to the tenant's own machine being installed; (2) what should happen to your existing machine (inspect/repair, remove, dispose); (3) who pays to disconnect and remove it and fit the new one; or would you prefer we send our contractor to inspect and repair/replace it?
options: Consent to tenant's own machine, tenant's property and removed at end of tenancy; advise on disposal of existing machine and who pays for removal/fitting
Agency contractor inspects the existing machine first (landlord approval to instruct)
Landlord arranges their own contractor or replacement

args.body: Hello, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Fitting your own machine needs the landlord's consent, so we've put your offer to them, including that it would stay yours and go with you when you leave. We've also asked what should happen to the current machine and who covers removal and fitting. Please don't remove or dispose of the current machine until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 30 July.
